editorial.blurb: Pancho Pistolas delivers genuinely flavorful Mexican cooking with well-seasoned meats and fresh horchata, though execution can be inconsistent and drinks carry a premium price.
editorial.insiderTip: Go at off-peak hours for smooth service and order the steak tacos or bistec à la Mexicana—regulars swear by them; skip the tamale appetizer and splurge on the fried ice cream instead.
